body.name: \beta_{\kappa}
body.construction: Under \(r_{0n}=n^{-a_0}\), \(r_{1n}=n^{-a_1}\), and \(r_{en}=n^{-a_e}\), define \(\beta_{\kappa}=\min\{1/2,\,\kappa/2+(1-\kappa)a_1\;\mathbf 1\{0<\kappa<1\}\text{ with this entry omitted for }\kappa\ge1,\,a_1+\kappa/[2(\kappa+1)],\,a_1+\kappa a_e/(\kappa+2),\,a_0+a_e\}\).
